# SK0215 — The static-member qualifier is not arranged

<!-- Generated from Rules/Rikarin.Skala.Rules.Metadata/rules.json. Do not edit. -->

`skala arrange` would add, remove or change a static-member type qualifier, or shorten a redundant namespace prefix on its type receiver.

| | |
|---|---|
| Category | Formatting |
| Default severity | suggestion |
| Scope | Semantic |
| Needs a compilation | yes |
| Fix | no |
| Language version floor | — |
| Since | 2.0 |

## Why

A qualifier can be removed or replaced only if the resulting reference resolves to the same static member. The rule binds both forms and the pipeline rejects any symbol change. A namespace-qualified receiver such as `Reporting.Fingerprints.Normalize(text)` becomes `Fingerprints.Normalize(text)` when the shorter expression already resolves to the same type; the static type qualifier remains when required by scope or configuration.

## Example

Instead of:

```csharp
Helpers.Create()
```

Write:

```csharp
Create()
```

## When it does not fire

Namespace prefixes are preserved when the short name is missing, ambiguous or shadowed by a local, parameter or another type. Explicit namespace aliases, global:: qualifiers, comments in the removed prefix and formatter-off regions are preserved. The pipeline rejects any remaining symbol change.

## Configuration

- `skala_static_members_qualify_members`
- `skala_static_members_qualify_with`
